description: Header file defining interfaces, macros, structures, and constants for NXP SAI driver in Zephyr RTOS, including configuration macros, register access, and utility functions.

methods.name: get_msel
methods.description: Determines the MCLK source selection value based on the BCLK source.

methods.name: set_msel
methods.description: Sets the MCR register's MSEL bits to select the MCLK source.

methods.name: clk_lookup_by_name
methods.description: Finds the index of a clock by its name in the clock data.

methods.name: get_mclk_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the rate of the specified MCLK source clock.

methods.name: get_bclk_default_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration for bit clock.

methods.name: get_fsync_default_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration for frame sync.

methods.name: sai_get_state
methods.description: Returns current state (RX or TX) of the SAI interface.

methods.name: sai_update_state
methods.description: Transitions the SAI interface to a new state with validation.

methods.name: sai_tx_rx_force_disable
methods.description: Disables the transmitter or receiver hardware.

methods.name: sai_tx_rx_sw_enable_disable
methods.description: Enables or disables the software control of TX or RX.

methods.name: count_leading_zeros
methods.description: Counts the number of leading zeros in a 32-bit word.

methods.name: sai_tx_rx_set_dline_mask
methods.description: Sets the data line mask for RX or TX.

methods.name: sai_dump_register_data
methods.description: Logs the current register values for debugging.
